response.sql: WITH event_ratio AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, SUM(spent) * 1.0 / SUM(amount) AS spend_ratio FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL AND spent IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL AND amount <> 0 GROUP BY link_to_event), avg_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) AS avg_spend_ratio FROM event_ratio) SELECT er.event_id, er.spend_ratio, er.spend_ratio / ar.avg_spend_ratio AS relative_spend_ratio FROM event_ratio er CROSS JOIN avg_ratio ar ORDER BY relative_spend_ratio IS NULL, relative_spend_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
